subject: BrightPath - GPU top-up & amendment for renewal
messages:
From: Sara Munroe <sara@brightpath.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning - capacity question

Hi Vanessa,

Quick one — our usage spiked unexpectedly in March after a new feature shipped. We're on the Dedicated fleet with the standard 16-GPU commitment, and Q1 billing shows sustained 85% utilization on peak days. Before we sign the renewal, the product team is asking whether we can add temporary capacity (or convert some of the commit to burst) for June–Aug to cover load, and what the pricing would look like. Can you share a short proposal/estimate?

I attached the Q1 traces and token counts.

Thanks,
Sara
Account Lead, BrightPath AI
Attachments: usage_report_q1.csv (CSV, 1.2MB)
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sara Munroe <sara@brightpath.ai>
Cc: dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: BrightPath - preliminary top-up proposal

Hi Sara — thanks for the data and the heads-up.

Quick summary of options after a first pass:
- Short-term top-up: 8 additional GPUs reserved for a 3-month addendum (June–Aug). Ideal if you want fixed capacity and consistent latency.
- Hybrid: 4 reserved + 4 burst-enabled (ephemeral) GPUs with autoscale. This reduces committed cost while preserving peak throughput.
- Software mitigations: we can apply more aggressive batching and a 4-bit quantization profile on the non-critical models to reduce token cost; that lowers effective utilization by ~15% per our estimates.

Attached is a one-page addendum (proposed_addendum_v1.pdf) with numbers and two pricing options (reserved vs hybrid). Ballpark monthly delta: $21k/mo (reserved 8 GPUs) vs $12k/mo (hybrid).

If you prefer, we can run a short perf sim against your traces (2–3 days) to validate the hybrid profile impact before we sign. Dev, can you confirm feasibility and latency impact for the hybrid approach?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192
Attachments: proposed_addendum_v1.pdf (PDF, 320KB)

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: BrightPath - recommended approach for June top-up

Team — quick internal note so we can reply to BrightPath with a firm plan by EOD Monday.

Context: BrightPath wants extra capacity by 1 Jun for a predicted traffic window through Aug. Q1 traces show high tail utilization on inference-heavy endpoints; sustained 85% peak utilization on their current 16-GPU pool.

Recommendation (my view):
- Offer the hybrid: 4x reserved GPUs + 4x burst-enabled GPUs (burst billed per-minute while active, no minimum monthly billing for burst). Rationale: reduces committed cost, preserves headroom for traffic spikes, and keeps margin for us.
- Include a perf-sim run (48h) on their traces to validate tail latency and error rate with a 4-bit quantization profile applied to non-critical rerank/rewrite models.
- Pricing: set a blended uplift so the customer sees predictable baseline + consumption for burst.

Dev: please confirm the perf sim timeline and expected latency delta for the hybrid config. Hannah: can you draft a one-page finance-friendly summary that shows cost delta vs reserved-only?

Thanks — I want to be explicit on billing mechanics and DocuSign workflow in our reply.

—Vanessa
From: dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Sara Munroe <sara@brightpath.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightPath - preliminary top-up proposal (technical note)

Hi all — technical notes and timeline:

- Burst billing: The burst GPUs will be billed at a per-minute rate and only when the instances are active. No monthly minimum for burst; reserved GPUs keep the baseline.
- Perf sim: We can run a 48-hour simulation against the Q1 traces you provided. We'll stand up a mirror fleet (4 reserved + 4 burst) and exercise the workloads. Expect to have the report and tail-latency CDF by EOD Tuesday (2027-04-06).
- Quantization: Recommend converting the reranker and assistant-response models to 4-bit int quantization first; we expect ~12–18% speedup with low- to negligible-perceived quality drop for most prompts, but we'll include a small manual eval set for BrightPath to review.
- Autoscale policy: Configure burst to scale up in 2-GPU increments with a 60s cooldown and hard cap at 8 burst GPUs for safety.

Attachments: perf_estimate_v2.xlsx (perf estimates and cost model).

If this looks good, Vanessa — we can attach an amendment that formalizes the 3-month hybrid addendum and the DocuSign flow, and schedule the perf sim to start tomorrow morning.

—Dev
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sara Munroe <sara@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Jacob Rosen <jrosen@brightpath.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: BrightPath - amendment and next steps (DocuSign link)

Sara / Jacob — thanks for the quick back-and-forth and for providing traces. Per our discussions and the perf team note, here's the agreed path:

1) Contract amendment (3 months, 1 Jun–31 Aug): 4 reserved GPUs + 4 burst-enabled GPUs. Burst billed per-minute when active, no minimum.
2) Perf-sim: Redwood will run the 48-hour validation window starting 2027-04-06; we'll share tail-latency CDF and a short quality sweep by 2027-04-08.
3) Quantization: We'll apply 4-bit to the reranker/assistant-response candidates and share subjective eval samples before production.
4) Pricing: see attached amendment. Blended uplift is $13,750/mo for the addendum (hybrid).

Next steps for BrightPath: please review and route the amendment to procurement. When you're ready, sign via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/brightpath/amendment/BP-2027-EXP-004

Attachments: amendment_20270405.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

Thanks — we'll kick the perf sim tomorrow morning and keep you updated on results.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
